action.query:
SELECT o.CUISINE, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_STATUS = 'Delivered' THEN o.SALES_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_STATUS = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCELLED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_STATUS = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DELIVERED_COUNT
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND o.CURRENCY = 'INR'
GROUP BY o.CUISINE
ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC
LIMIT 10;
